output: Direct continuous-amount curve at supported values, no binning/smoothing a handful of treatment arms, no forced increasing shape. Same task duration,requested amplitude,target population and incentive unit within one curve.

Shared user-group folds,cluster-level sampling inference,amount units and support domain are common adaptation conditions for both baseline and proposed method, not novelty.
one_improvement_hypothesis: For outcome cumulative timeY in[0,T], use a soft two-part outcome nuisance m(a,X)=P(Y>0|a,X)*E[Y|Y>0,a,X], with bounded positive conditional mean. Keep the continuous DML correction and all events. No thresholding predicted response probability, no hard zero gate, no conditioning estimand on responders.
scientific_status: Two-part outcome models and continuousDML are established. This is a task-specific adaptation hypothesis whose independent benefit must be demonstrated; not yet a new estimator or established publication-level novelty. ObservationY>0 is not identified willingness/participation.
limits_of_hypothesis: A bounded auxiliary mean does not force corrected finalDML estimates into[0,T]. Do not post-hoc clip final curves or impose monotonicity to create gains. Raw net energy can be negative and must not be placed into this positive-time hurdle structure without its own justified model.
fair_comparison: Same observations,users,amount domain,query locations,GPS model,bandwidth rule,tuning budget and uncertainty method. Difference only outcome nuisance structure. Match base-learner flexibility/feature basis and add capacity-matched control if two-part gains could come merely from larger learner budget. Retain oldcontinuousDR as reference.

metrics: Primary continuous-curve contrast RMSE on a common predefined supported domain; joint output coverage so declining to estimate is not scored as improvement. Also zeroeffect false-positive behavior,boundary/marginal-return bias if explicitly examined,and cluster inference coverage if claimed. stop_rule: First reproduce and compare currentDR versus correctDML. Choose justified baseline using development only. Try the one preregistered two-part hypothesis; one independent finalconfirmation.
